name: Host Guardian Service Installer
description: A sequential three-script PowerShell workflow that provisions a Windows Server node as an HGS cluster member across mandatory reboots: installing prerequisites and renaming the machine, initializing the HGS domain and AD forest, and configuring the HGS service with TPM attestation mode and signing/encryption certificates.

name: Group Policy Baseline Importer
description: A PowerShell script that bulk-imports seven GPO backups representing the Microsoft Security Baseline 2019 into an Active Directory domain, covering Domain Controllers, Member Servers, Workstations, Credential Guard, Virtualization-Based Security, Defender Antivirus, and core domain policies.
